title: The degree-thirteen projection misses a certified positive Fisher complement at the slab-two KKT point
method: Evaluate the exact degree-thirteen odd-Hermite Gram projection at K1788's rational slab-two KKT checkpoint, compare it exactly with the admitted threshold, then subtract it from K1788's Arb-certified full-Fisher value lower endpoint.
scope_guard: The exact degree-thirteen projection lies more than 1e-15 below the threshold at the actual slab-two KKT point even though the full Fisher value lies above it. The missing positive complement exceeds 2.5e-14 there. Deeper Bernstein subdivision or raw finite-degree projection alone cannot certify the point; the next valid local method must lower-bound that complement or directly enclose the full Fisher functional.
